purpose: T2 on the T1 XY-column cells of the pilot prism: 2D-a inter-view warp-NCC of the current images through each candidate height field (current MVS top layer M, Existing ALS top layer P at delta0 = 0) with candidate-specific visibility, per-candidate and paired (common view pair) statistics, synthetic-shift control candidates that measure the channel's own power, and the auxiliary 2D-b depth-edge to image-edge distance. Evidence only; no responsibility, weight, registration or change verdict. [P2: H_M candidate site (east sawtooth roof, near-nadir coverage); r2 settings unchanged; PRIOR_ABOVE expectation mirrored (delta_sign -1).] [injection bench V2: als_shift_all (H_delta_z); inputs are the perturbed partition copies under phase-payloads/phd/injection_bench_v1/PHD-INJECTION-BENCH-v1/V2; the relation map is the frozen original]

current_cameras.view_selection: the exact view list frozen by the T1 evidence bank (evidence_views.json)
current_cameras.image_use: 2D-a inter-view photometric consistency and 2D-b image edges only; no model colour; image bytes are hashed against the T1 view list

algorithm.name: WARP_NCC_2DA_EDGE_2DB_v1

candidates.M: current-image MVS top-layer height field (pairing mvs_z)
candidates.P: Existing ALS top-layer height field at delta0 = 0 (pairing als_z)

pairs.angle_reference: prism centre at the median M height

chips.pair_choice: summary-band common pair whose angle is closest to 10 deg (M-only or P-only pair otherwise)

algorithm.provenance: tolerance 0.5 m = T1 ray tolerance (C4 registration envelope); window 2 m / sigma 0.5 m / step 0.125 m / n_eff 30 / std 2 / good 0.5 / margin 0.1 / min pairs 3 / angle 3-60 deg / edge jump 1 m / Canny 50/150 are new placeholders registered before the run, not frozen; r2: summary_angle_max_deg 20 (post-r1 adjustment, see revision_r2), chip target 10 deg

COMPATIBLE.visibility: n_pairs(M) median >= 3; P_2Da(M) majority (near-nadir views exist over this site)

PRIOR_ABOVE.visibility: n_views(P) > n_views(M) (ridges above the MVS roof)
PRIOR_ABOVE.2D-a: delta <= -0.2 median, f_P>M >= 0.7, S_M <= 0.5: the current images support the ALS ridges, not the low MVS roof (H_M signature, opposite sign to the pilot)

CONTROLS.2D-a: AUC(z 2 m) >= 0.9, AUC(z 1 m) >= 0.75, AUC(z 0.5 m) >= 0.6, AUC(x 1 m) ~ 0.5 on COMPATIBLE planar cells

BENCH.V7_vs_V8: V7 (MVS biased up) shows 3D-b BLOCK dominant and 2D-a delta < 0 (P explains the images); V8 (ALS lifted) shows PENETRATE dominant and delta > 0: opposite signs in both channels
BENCH.V5: MVS pairs 0, NO_LANDING dominant, S_P stays >= 0.6 (the images do not contradict P)
BENCH.V1_V2_V3: compatible cells move to PRIOR_ABOVE from delta_z 0.5 with PENETRATE and delta > 0 (the sequential reading confuses registration with change); dz across cells is coherent (variance <= 0.1 m2, sign agreement >= 0.95), unlike V8's local patches
BENCH.V4: horizontal 1 m shift is unobservable on horizontal ground (dz ~ 0, delta ~ 0); signal only on slopes / walls

revision_r2.trigger: r1 (pairs 3-60 deg, pre-registered) angle-stratified analysis of the stored per-pair rho: at 3-10 deg the true surface scores rho_M ~0.88 and the old roof rho_P ~0.40 (paired delta +0.27, f(M>P) 0.83, 1 m vertical control f 0.63), while for theta >= 20 deg every candidate collapses to rho ~0 (December low sun: moving shadows between strips; anisotropic 2 m windows in 65 deg off-nadir views)
revision_r2.unchanged: the bank (ncc_pair_values_f16.npy) still holds every pair 3-60 deg with its angle; wide-band medians are kept per cell (n_pairs_wide_*, ncc_median_wide_*, delta_median_wide)

restated_expectations.CONTROLS_PAIRED_r2: paired per-pair fraction in the band: f(M > M+z2) >= 0.65, f(M > M+z1) >= 0.6, f(M > M+z0.5) >= 0.4, f(M > M+x1) <= 0.2
restated_expectations.note: the pre-registered cell-level AUC checks are kept and reported as-is; the paired form is the fairer statement of a comparator channel

revision_r2.p2_note: P2 reuses the r2 summary band (<= 20 deg) registered on the pilot; whether the band generalises is one of the questions this prism answers
